senses.gloss:
mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 Not to be used or enjoyed.
2 Not to be eaten.
E.
अ neg. भुज to eat, &c. तव्य aff.

m. (-क्ता)
An abstemious person.
mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ)
Not enjoying, not using.
E.
अ neg. भोक्तृ who enjoys.

m. (-गः)
Non-enjoyment, not making use of.
E.
अ neg. भोग enjoyment.

m. (-गः)
1 Completion, fulness.
2 Enjoyment.
3 Effort, pains.
4 The expanded hood of the Cobra capella, used by VARUṆA as his umbrella.
E.
आङ्, भुज to eat, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
Not to be used or enjoyed.
E.
अ neg. भोग्य to be used.

n. (-नं)
Abstinence, fasting.
E.
अ neg. भोजन food.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Not to be eaten.
2 Not to be used.
E.
अ neg. भोजनीय to be eaten, &c.

mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि)
Fasting.
E.
अ neg. भोजिन् who eats.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
Impure, prohibited as food, not to be eaten.
E.
अ neg. भोज्य to be eaten, &c.
